question: What ritual sequence follows the internal placement of the mātṛkā?
premises: The inner mātṛkā is first placed within.
The placement is completed before the next act.
The practitioner should then perform nyāsa on all limbs.
inference: Therefore after placing the inner mātṛkā one should perform nyāsa on all limbs.
plain_english: Thus, having placed the mātṛkā within, one should perform the nyāsa on all the limbs.
